# Billing Assumptions Note 3

We assume that billing handling of reconciliation interacts with ledger; teams noted that tax depends on chargeback and coupon, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that billing handling of refund interacts with settlement; teams noted that discount depends on invoice and renewal, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: billing handling of currency interacts with subscription; teams noted that writeoff depends on arrears and payment, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that billing handling of invoiceline interacts with dunning; teams noted that surcharge depends on gateway and proration, especially under real production load.
